svg.text: Using ARPD: setup, planning, execution and steering
The researcher (PI) leads a team of AI agents in Claude Code. Agents do the work between the gates; at each gate the PI decides in their own words.
Setup runs once. Planning and execution repeat for every sprint. Steering and upkeep can happen any time after setup, whenever their trigger arises.
